annotations.title: Substations and published headroom near a site

description:
Primary substations near a site, nearest first, with each network
    operator's published demand and generation headroom, voltage and
    distance; renewable energy projects (REPD) nearby; and which operators'
    figures we hold. Headroom is the operator's heat-map figure on its file
    date, NOT a connection offer. A substation with headroom null says why
    (the operator's figures are not loaded, or none is published for it);
    that is never "no capacity". Give exactly ONE scope: `location` ("lat,lng"), `postcode`,
    `area_geojson` (a red line, GeoJSON in WGS84, at most 150 km² and 64
    vertices), `land_id` or `lpa_code` (GSS, e.g. E07000240); anything else is
    refused before any read and nothing is charged. GB. Free.
name: grid_capacity
title: Substations and published headroom near a site
